correctness.rationale: The proof derives the WMMS upper bound from the weighted average of normalized partition values, evaluates the two split partitions when both singleton values are positive, and treats the remaining sign cases separately. In the all-negative case, after relabeling so the first entitlement is at least the second, the exact values are negative the minimum of 2 and the entitlement ratio, and negative the minimum of 1 and twice the reciprocal ratio. No numerical search is used to prove the universal claim.

It distinguishes a true three-item obstruction from known two-item failures that depend on a broader valuation class; this is a precise structural boundary, not a routine numerical recomputation.
